curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use the title and the pictures to make predictions about a story

interactions.prompt: The title is “The Lost Ball.” What will the story probably be about?
interactions.feedback: Good prediction! The title gives a strong clue.
interactions.retryHint: Use the important words lost and ball.

interactions.prompt: The picture shows a child looking under a bed. What may happen next?
choices: The child may find something under the bed.
The child may fly a plane.
The child may swim in a river.
interactions.answer: The child may find something under the bed.
interactions.feedback: Smart clue work! Your prediction matches the picture.
interactions.retryHint: Choose what could happen in the place shown.

interactions.prompt: Title: “Rainy-Day Rescue.” Picture: a kitten beside a puddle. What is a sensible prediction?
choices: Someone may help the kitten stay dry.
The kitten will build a rocket.
The sun will become a bicycle.
interactions.answer: Someone may help the kitten stay dry.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You joined the title and picture clues.
interactions.retryHint: Use both rain and the kitten's situation.

interactions.prompt: Title: “A Seed's Surprise.” Picture: a green shoot in soil. What may the seed become?
interactions.feedback: That prediction grows from the clues!
interactions.retryHint: Think about what grows from a seed.

interactions.prompt: Title: “The Helpful Neighbour.” Picture: a woman carrying a heavy basket while a boy walks toward her. What may happen?
choices: The boy may help carry the basket.
The basket may drive a bus.
They may hide from each other.
interactions.answer: The boy may help carry the basket.
interactions.feedback: Strong prediction! It fits the title and the action in the picture.
interactions.retryHint: Ask who could be helpful in the scene.

interactions.prompt: Which prediction method is strongest before reading a story?
choices: connect clues from both the title and pictures
interactions.answer: connect clues from both the title and pictures
interactions.feedback: Prediction quest complete! You know how story clues work together.
interactions.retryHint: Remember the two clues: title plus pictures.
